capabilities: Open 1000+ file extensions read-only inside the vault
Show any file as a hex view, file information, or a comparison with another file
Remember reading positions for books and long documents
Open Markdown notes in a book-like reading view
Resolve extension conflicts with other plugins that open the same formats
disambiguation: Not an editor: it opens files read-only and never changes them.
extras: Marked alpha with a backup warning and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Rare heavy formats (7z, RTF, CAD, HDF5, Flash) need a separately downloaded libs pack. Free with a Boosty donation link. Fully offline; PDF stays in Obsidian's own viewer and KeePass databases show info only, never passwords.
problem: Obsidian natively opens only a few file types, so vault attachments like e-books, spreadsheets, databases or archives must be opened in external apps.
summary: Read-only file viewer that opens 1000+ file formats (EPUB, DOCX, XLSX, SQLite, comics, archives, 3D models) inside the vault.
